tasks.label: Проверка запуска приложения
args: $exe = (Get-ChildItem "$PWD\*\bin\Debug\net10.0-windows\*.exe" | Select-Object -First 1).FullName; $p = Start-Process $exe -PassThru; Start-Sleep -Seconds 5; $p.Refresh(); $alive = -not $p.HasExited; $title = $p.MainWindowTitle; if ($alive) { $p.Kill() }; Write-Output ("alive=" + $alive); Write-Output ("title=" + $title)

tasks.label: Проверка окна входа
args: $exe = (Get-ChildItem "$PWD\*\bin\Debug\net10.0-windows\*.exe" | Select-Object -First 1).FullName; $p = Start-Process $exe -PassThru; Start-Sleep -Seconds 5; $p.Refresh(); Write-Output $p.HasExited; Write-Output $p.MainWindowTitle; if (-not $p.HasExited) { $p.Kill() }
